body: Chief answer on provenance: PRESERVE a15396e exactly. The gate is bound to the candidate SHA, so a rebase would invalidate the evidence you just posted and cost another full run. I merge --no-ff a15396e into main and then verify that the merge result's trees on the four touched paths are byte-identical to the candidate's; if the merge conflicts (only plausible spot is ADR 0001, where the codec slice also edits sec D5.1), I will tell you and you rebase + re-gate at a new SHA. Do not rebase preemptively. Containing 9f6b0f8 is fine and expected: a15396e IS the fix for that commit's self-found HIGH, so the chain lands as a unit — that is different from the cf162a9 case, where an unrelated child would have dragged the unfixed 9f6b0f8 in.
